title: Indus River flood near Sukkur
thresholdReason: -22.25 dB on the HV channel, calibrated so that it best separates JRC permanent water from never-flooded land in this area (HH could not separate the turbulent river from dry land). Because JRC was used to calibrate, the JRC agreement shown is not an independent check.
headline: Did the Indus spill across its floodplain during the 2026 monsoon flood?
event: Pakistan's Flood Forecasting Division reported the Indus at medium flood level at the Guddu and Sukkur barrages at the end of July 2026; by 30 August Sukkur had receded to low flood.

references.title: Dawn: Parts of Punjab, Sindh face urban flooding risk (1 Aug 2026)

title: Brahmaputra flood around Majuli
headline: How far did the July 2026 Upper Assam flood spread around Majuli?
event: Assam University's 2026 flood report describes the July 2026 Upper Assam floods (about 2.12 lakh people displaced) and a 20 July embankment breach in Jorhat that flooded villages and cut ferry links to Majuli.

references.title: Assam University: Report on the 2026 Assam floods
Sentinel Assam: Brahmaputra erosion puts lower Majuli at risk

title: Tarbela Reservoir filling
thresholdReason: -13 dB on the HH channel, calibrated so that it best separates JRC permanent water from never-flooded land in this area (wind-roughened reservoir water is brighter than the default -18 dB). Because JRC was used to calibrate, the JRC agreement shown is not an independent check.
headline: How much did Tarbela's lake grow as monsoon and snowmelt water arrived?
event: WAPDA figures reported by Dawn show Tarbela rising from 1,504 ft on 16 July to 1,537 ft on 31 July 2026; the 30 August flood bulletin lists it at its 1,550 ft maximum conservation level.

references.title: Dawn: Tarbela level rose from 1,504 ft to 1,537 ft (1 Aug 2026)
